goal: Speeds up the wallet-spend fuzz target by building the fuzzed wallet once and resetting it between inputs instead of rebuilding it every time, cutting the descriptor-import cost paid on every input.
Benefits fuzzing contributors and CI by letting more inputs run per unit of time.

result.summary: This PR changes the wallet_create_transaction fuzz target to build the FuzzedWallet once in the target's .init hook and reuse it across inputs via a new Reset() method, instead of importing eight descriptors and deriving fresh addresses for every fuzz input. It adds a test-only CWallet::ClearInMemoryTxStateForTest() to drop in-memory transaction state cheaply, and precomputes a pool of destinations/change addresses to avoid repeated BIP32 derivation and WalletBatch writes. The author reports a ~6x local speedup; a reviewer independently reproduced a ~4x speedup on the qa-assets corpus.
result.problem: Rebuilding FuzzedWallet from scratch on every fuzz input pays BIP32 derivation and three WalletBatch writes per address before the target even reaches the code under test, wasting most of the fuzzer's time on setup rather than exploring the target logic.

result.card: This PR speeds up the wallet_create_transaction fuzz target by building the FuzzedWallet once per process and resetting its in-memory transaction state between inputs, rather than reimporting eight descriptors and deriving new addresses on every input. It adds a small test-only CWallet::ClearInMemoryTxStateForTest() helper and a precomputed pool of destinations to avoid repeated BIP32 derivation and wallet-database writes. The author measured a ~6x local speedup and reviewer jeanpablojp independently reproduced ~4x on the qa-assets corpus, giving an Approach ACK; both inline concerns raised (index drift tracking, clear-call ordering) were resolved without objection after a 2026-09-07 force push. The change is test infrastructure only, with no effect on production wallet behavior or fund safety. No dependencies are stated; it only conflicts textually with the unrelated #35511 CAmount refactor.
